label: Sizing one rectangle
subgoals: Add or subtract 2d from each dimension
Detect a dimension that collapses to zero or less
Multiply the new dimensions to get the area

label: Sizing merges shapes
subgoals: Compute the overlap of the grown shapes
Merge the grown shapes by inclusion-exclusion

label: Closing and opening
subgoals: Grow and then shrink by the same distance for a closing
Compare the gap with 2d to decide whether it fills
Report the area of the closed result
